messages:
Jamie L: Canary 6 rolled at 03:12 UTC. Noticing rapid KV cache RSS growth on ~10% of INT8 pods. No obvious request surge. Pushing logs and a quick profile below.
Maya S: :eyes: RSS or slot_count? any change in eviction_rate?
Jamie L: RSS + slot_count up. Eviction spikes correlate with kernel fallback logs. snippet: `kernel_select: chosen=quant_fast fallback=matmul_fp`
Arjun P: That fallback is weird — should only hit for longctx > 2048. Are these requests using long contexts or large batch sizes?
Jamie L: Batch sizes look normal (<=8). Sample trace shows a few longctx chains from a rouge tenant (chat transcript ingestion).
Dmitri: Can we get the pprof KV hotpaths? ran `./bin/runtime profile --kv --top=20 --since=2m` and saw hot: `slot_reclaim`, `page_compact`, `kernel_fallback_check`
Maya S: paste of kv-stats dump: ```
kv.total_slots: 524288
kv.used_slots: 372192
kv.fragmented_pages: 441
kv.evictions_last_5m: 2847
kv.eviction_rate_per_min: 569
quant.profile: INT8
avg_slot_size_bytes: 2456
```
Arjun P: Fragmented pages 441 is notable. INT8 reduces page occupancy so small allocations create more holes. If kernel falls back to fp matmul, latency causes pending requests to hold KV refs longer -> eviction churn.
Jamie L: TL;DR: interplay of kernel selection fallback + longctx chains -> slots held -> fragmentation -> eviction surge. Need mitigation ASAP.
Maya S: Quick mitigations? bump eviction_threshold? tune kernel selection to avoid fallback for INT8? change batching heuristic?
Dmitri: Short-term: set `kv.eviction_threshold=0.78` -> earlier reclaim, reduces RSS but risks more cache misses. Also deploy kernel selection patch that avoids fallback when quant profile==INT8 unless memory pressure high.
Jamie L: Canaryed the eviction_threshold change on the affected pool. ops-bot reports fewer evictions after 4m.
ops-bot: deploy: canary/evict-threshold-0.78 -> success on 3/3 pods :white_check_mark: (duration 4m)
Maya S: Good. We should also run an accuracy sweep — earlier we saw INT8 recall drop ~0.2% vs BF16 when lots of warmup evictions happen. Need baseline prompts.
Arjun P: Agreed. Scheduler idea: defer large longctx requests to dedicated lane with larger per-request slot reservation to avoid thrashing small-use slots. Also consider slot coalescing heuristics (merge adjacent tiny allocations).
Jamie L: Action items: 1) Roll threshold to prod for affected pools (Dmitri) 2) Kernel selection conservative patch (Arjun) 3) Run accuracy baseline for INT8 under higher eviction (Maya) 4) Add sampling profiler to detect kernel_fallback hotspots (Jamie).
Dmitri: I'll open PR for threshold roll, and a dashboard panel for eviction vs recall.
Maya S: I'll prepare the eval harness inputs and run BF16/INT8 A/B with eviction stress. Expect results in ~6 hours.
Arjun P: I'll prototype the kernel selection guard and a small unit test to reproduce fallback with artificial longctx hold.
Jamie L: Thanks all. If anyone notices new pods with >1.2GB KV RSS ping here. :bell:
Maya S: noted. Will also annotate canary timeline in the incident doc.
Dmitri: adding follow-up to weekly perf sync.
Jamie L: closing thread for now, will reopen if evictions spike again. :handshake:
